instruction: Adversarial review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020C.1 at safety/bypass lens. Slice adds waiver-aware Rego, caller-side rule-config override, conflict-gate (rego vs python), and a commit-status read-back. Hunt for SILENT BYPASS holes — the pattern that historically kills these systems. SPECIFICALLY ATTACK: (1) malformed or missing data.waivers (object instead of list, list with non-object members, missing rule_id, missing expires_at) — does scp_active_waiver_for fall safely closed, or can a malformed waiver suppress a deny it shouldn't? (2) malformed rule-config (no rules key, rules with invalid SCP-R-NNN, disable as string "true" instead of bool, expires_at missing) — does scp_rule_config_disabled fall closed; does the schema-validate step catch all malformed shapes BEFORE conftest sees them? (3) past-dated rule-config disable — spec says still-suppresses-for-one-release; verify the workflow ALWAYS emits the ::warning:: annotation when expiry has passed (not just on the next release) and that the schema permits past dates rather than rejecting them outright; (4) waiver applied but with no expires_at — should NOT suppress (treated as expired); verify scp_active_waiver_for body fails when expires_at == "" / missing; (5) expired waiver crafted to look unexpired via timezone manipulation ("2099-12-31T23:59:59-12:00") — does scp_dateish_ns regex accept it and does the comparison hold; (6) does the lib data-wrapping handle a malformed waivers.json (json.load failure) gracefully — what runs through to conftest then; (7) the scp/policy-check-readback commit-status posts state=success unconditionally even when the main check denies — is that misleading; (8) statuses:write permission grant and scope; (9) yaml.safe_load vs yaml.load (RCE risk); (10) does the conflict-gate adapter compare the right verdict fields, or could a Rego deny with verdict='waived' be silently mis-classified vs python; (11) does the one-release rule-config grace allow an indefinite bypass if a developer keeps editing the expires_at into the past on every PR. Per WP-SCP-022 §4.3 fixpoint criteria. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON.
